verdict.delta: control median_ms minus candidate median_ms, separate processes, repeat=1

reject_conditions.F: Sum of 53 phase maxima from original global producer completion through every reader's fold staging (final head: norm-ready) must be strictly shorter than both shipped and matching controls; record all 424 per-XCD intervals.
reject_conditions.K: Charge 2304 B read + 2304 B written per XCD/layer. Both 27-phase kv_post-ready and attention-body-ready tail sums must shrink versus shipped and matching controls. Reject if measured q_c producer/kv_post overlap was positive for any control reader and vanishes in the corresponding candidate reader; report per-reader and per-layer overlap.
reject_conditions.FK: Require F and K kept; repeat both screens versus shipped/matching-off controls and isolate F versus combined-binary K graph, K versus combined-binary F graph. Timing must beat shipped and combined-binary F-only controls.

nice_to_have: Text timelines from already captured traces, after final validation; no extra GPU capture.
